description: Host -> companion event reporting whether the host currently has a run in progress (Q1-Q10 decision, transcribed 2026-11-01). state is required and is exactly one of idle (no run in progress) or running (a run is in progress). Unknown fields are allowed (v1 ignore-unknown rule).

uuid.description: Fresh UUID v4 per message in real runs. Type is string only: no format is enforced because the shipped fixtures use the placeholder string "<uuid>", which is not a valid UUID.

v.description: Contract version, currently 1. The companion events are additive in v1, so v stays 1 (Q1-Q10 decision: no version bump).

title: companion-ws v1 host_status event (APP-2 M1)
